plugin-data.name: Admin URI Refilter
plugin-data.description: Modifies the ADMIN_URI_FILTER constant in variables.php to customize your admin panel URL, with automatic recovery support after core updates.

file-not-writable-warning: Warning: The core file is not writable. Please change permissions to 666 for:
core-rewrite-success-alert: The admin URL has been customized to "%s". Please use this new URL for your next access.
core-rewrite-redirect-prompt: The core file has been successfully rewritten. Please move to the new Admin URI workspace.
